newsitem.title: UK: BT telemarket centers to create 2,000 British jobs.
newsitem.headline: BT telemarket centers to create 2,000 British jobs.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc, which is set to merge with MCI Communications Corp., said Monday it planned to open two telemarketing centres, creating some 2,000 jobs in northern England.
The telecommunications giant said the centres would cost about 15 million pounds ($24.4 million) each.
The centres, in Doncaster, South Yorkshire, and on North Tyneside, will open in the fall.

"We believe it is vital to get closer to our customers by regular phone contact so that we can understand them better. .. Our teams at Doncaster and North Tyneside will help us achieve this," BT said in a statement.
BT also planned a "significant" expansion of its existing telemarketing operations in Glasgow, Scotland.
